causal_policy: Experiment assignment supports causal evaluation only when assignment/exposure and planned metric are present; observational correlations remain MODEL_ANALYSIS and must not be narrated as causal.

immutability.arms: experiment_arms.id, experiment_id and created_at are immutable after INSERT. While the unchanged parent remains DRAFT only arm_key, description and is_control may change; no arm INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE after parent leaves DRAFT.
immutability.assignment: experiment_assignments.id, experiment_id, arm_id, unit_type, unit_id, assigned_at and created_at are immutable after INSERT; only exposed_at may transition NULL -> DB statement_timestamp exactly once while RUNNING.
immutability.historical_outcomes: analytics/earnings remain linked through assigned clip/post/account/run and are never rewritten
immutability.design: hypothesis, feature_key, primary_metric and unit_type may change only on an update that remains DRAFT; they cannot change in the same statement that transitions out of DRAFT or at any later status.
immutability.experiments: experiments.id and created_at are immutable from INSERT onward. After leaving DRAFT, hypothesis/feature_key/primary_metric/unit_type are immutable; after leaving RUNNING, ended_at and captured stopping_reason are immutable; STOPPED -> COMPLETED preserves both.

assignment_immutability: Assignments may be INSERTed only while RUNNING; assignment.unit_type must equal experiment.unit_type; assigned_at/created_at are DB-authored; id/experiment_id/arm_id/unit_type/unit_id/assigned_at/created_at are immutable; exposed_at may transition NULL->DB statement_timestamp exactly once while RUNNING and cannot precede started_at/assigned_at.
outcome_linkage: clip.experiment_assignment_id and generation/candidate/allocation assignment IDs allow analytics/earnings to be joined via clip->post; no duplicate experiment metric store is authoritative
causal_claim_rule: Only results from explicit experiment assignments/exposure and predeclared primary metric may be described as experiment evidence. Observational correlations remain MODEL_ANALYSIS and are not causal facts.

predeclaration.run_gate: DRAFT->RUNNING requires at least two arms and exactly one control arm; started_at is DB statement_timestamp.
predeclaration.v1_control_rule: exactly one experiment_arms.is_control=true; at least one non-control arm

end_chronology: RUNNING->STOPPED|COMPLETED|CANCELLED and DRAFT->CANCELLED establish ended_at with DB statement_timestamp. STOPPED->COMPLETED preserves the already-established ended_at; terminal design/assignments remain immutable.

scope_matrix.run_campaign_allocations.experiment_assi: experiment.unit_type=GENERATION_RUN => assignment.unit_id=generation_run_id; experiment.unit_type=SOCIAL_ACCOUNT => assignment.unit_id=social_account_id; CLIP scope is not legal on allocation
scope_matrix.clips.experiment_assignment_id: CLIP => unit_id=clips.id; inherited GENERATION_RUN => unit_id=clips.generation_run_id; inherited SOCIAL_ACCOUNT => unit_id=clips.social_account_id. No other linkage.
scope_matrix.causal_consumers: Analytics/Polli may treat an assignment as experiment evidence only after this exact linkage and exposure chronology validate.

serialization_contract.parent_lock: Every experiment_arms INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and experiment_assignments INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE obtains SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the parent experiments row before checking status. The experiment status transition itself holds the same row lock.
serialization_contract.draft_boundary: DRAFT -> RUNNING sees the final committed arm set; no arm mutation can commit after the parent leaves DRAFT.
serialization_contract.running_boundary: RUNNING termination serializes with assignment admission; no assignment can commit after the parent leaves RUNNING.
serialization_contract.stopping_history: RUNNING -> STOPPED/COMPLETED/CANCELLED DB-authors ended_at and freezes stopping_reason. STOPPED -> COMPLETED preserves both exactly.
serialization_contract.arm_identity: INSERT locks/checks NEW parent DRAFT. UPDATE/DELETE locks/checks OLD parent; experiment_id cannot change even between two DRAFT experiments; id and created_at are immutable. Only arm_key/description/is_control may change while the same OLD parent remains DRAFT.
serialization_contract.row_identity: experiments.id/created_at and experiment_assignments.id are independently guarded as immutable; foreign keys are not relied on to protect primary historical identity.
